text:
Sawyer & Company Inc bought a new position in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in the 4th quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor bought 46,318 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock, valued at approximately $7,838,000. Apple accounts for about 5.1% of Sawyer & Company Inc’s holdings, making the stock its largest holding. 
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Janus Henderson Group PLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 301.3% during the second quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,003,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,880,992,000 after buying an additional 15,018,790 shares during the period. Truepoint Inc. boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 15,559.4% during the third quarter. Truepoint Inc. now owns 4,436,774 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,437,000 after buying an additional 4,408,441 shares during the period. Capital Research Global Investors boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 15.0% during the second quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,241,383,000 after buying an additional 3,845,363 shares during the period. Stifel Financial Corp raised its holdings in Apple by 9,166.4% during the third quarter. Stifel Financial Corp now owns 3,883,754 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $598,497,000 after purchasing an additional 3,841,842 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Harding Loevner LP raised its holdings in Apple by 784,734.3% during the third quarter. Harding Loevner LP now owns 3,296,304 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $188,966,000 after purchasing an additional 3,295,884 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.35% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $164.94 on Monday. The firm has a market cap of $836,907.75, a price-to-earnings ratio of 16.95, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.25 and a beta of 1.19. Apple has a 1-year low of $138.62 and a 1-year high of $183.50. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the business earned $3.36 EPS. equities research analysts expect that Apple will post 11.38 earnings per share for the current year. 
AAPL has been the subject of several analyst reports. Nomura set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, November 27th. UBS set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, November 27th. Vetr raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $177.17 price target for the company in a report on Wednesday, November 29th. Tigress Financial reissued a “strong-buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 6th. Finally, KeyCorp reissued a “buy” rating and set a $192.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $201.69. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.06% of the stock is owned by company insiders.

Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
